hookText: POV: you try to read your iPad in the sun
hookVisual: Creator selfie on a sunny balcony, holds a glossy LumioTab up to the camera; the screen is a mirror of the sky

beats.visual: Creator selfie on a sunny balcony, holds a glossy LumioTab up; screen is all reflection
beats.vo: POV: you try to read your iPad in the sun.
beats.onScreenText: POV: your iPad in the sun

beats.visual: Close-up of the glossy screen mirroring her face, she squints and tilts it
beats.vo: Glare everywhere, and my eyes hurt after an hour.

beats.visual: Split screen under a ring light: glossy tablet left full of reflections, matte LumioTab right, clean
beats.vo: This matte screen kills reflections completely.

beats.visual: Macro extreme close-up of text on the matte screen, paper-like texture
beats.vo: It honestly reads like actual paper.

beats.visual: Hands scrolling an e-book in bed at night, warm screen, TÜV badge pops
beats.vo: And it's certified easy on the eyes.

beats.visual: End card: LumioTab packshot, coupon ticket with code READ20, arrow pointing down
beats.vo: Grab it with code READ20, link below.

proofDevices.description: split-screen glare test under a ring light

whyItWorks: Opens on a relatable POV pain everyone with a glossy tablet knows, agitates it with a face-in-the-reflection close-up, then resolves with a side-by-side demo before two quick proofs and a code close.
